macro.title: Regulatory Shifts
macro.body: Recent developments in global regulatory environments may impact trade patterns and sector rotations. This could lead to shifts in the global economic landscape, affecting various industries and markets.
macro.bull: A more favorable regulatory environment could boost economic growth, benefiting the portfolio's holdings.
macro.base: Regulatory changes may have a neutral impact on the portfolio, with some sectors benefiting and others being negatively affected.
macro.bear: Stricter regulations could lead to decreased economic activity, negatively impacting the portfolio's holdings.

macro.title: Credit Market Trends
macro.body: Credit market trends may influence the portfolio's fixed income holdings and overall asset allocation. Changes in credit spreads and interest rates could impact the portfolio's performance.
macro.bull: Improving credit market conditions could lead to increased demand for credit assets, benefiting the portfolio.
macro.base: Credit market trends may have a minimal impact on the portfolio, with other factors driving performance.
macro.bear: Deteriorating credit market conditions could lead to decreased demand for credit assets, negatively impacting the portfolio.

macro.title: Equity Sector Rotations
macro.body: Equity sector rotations may significantly impact the portfolio's performance, as different sectors experience varying levels of growth and volatility.
macro.bull: A rotation into growth sectors could benefit the portfolio's holdings, such as tech and finance.
macro.base: Sector rotations may have a neutral impact on the portfolio, with some sectors performing well and others poorly.
macro.bear: A rotation out of growth sectors could negatively impact the portfolio's holdings, leading to decreased performance.

risks.title: Leverage Amplification Risk
risks.context: 49% of portfolio (~ $135K CAD) in leveraged ETFs
risks.body: The portfolio's significant allocation to leveraged ETFs, such as FNGU and SPXL, amplifies both gains and losses. This increases the risk of substantial losses if the market declines.

risks.title: FX Exposure Risk
risks.context: 68% USD exposure (~ $180K CAD) with a FX book of 1.3925
risks.body: The portfolio's substantial USD exposure and FX book value may result in losses if the CAD strengthens against the USD.

risks.title: Earnings Concentration Risk
risks.context: Tech sector holdings, such as NVDA and MSFT, have significant earnings impact
risks.body: The portfolio's concentration in tech sector holdings, particularly NVDA and MSFT, may lead to increased volatility if these companies experience earnings disappointments.

news.headline: TSLA Stock Rises As Swedish Union Ends Strike
news.body: The end of the Swedish union strike may positively impact TSLA's production and sales, benefiting the portfolio's holding.

outcomes.label: Bull
outcomes.scenario: TSLA's stock price increases due to improved production and sales.

outcomes.label: Base
outcomes.scenario: The strike's end has a neutral impact on TSLA's stock price.

outcomes.label: Bear
outcomes.scenario: The strike's end does not significantly impact TSLA's stock price, and other factors drive performance.

news.headline: NVDA Stock Jumps On Positive Earnings
news.body: NVDA's positive earnings report may lead to increased investor confidence and a higher stock price, benefiting the portfolio's holding.

outcomes.label: Bull
outcomes.scenario: NVDA's stock price increases significantly due to strong earnings and growth prospects.

outcomes.label: Base
outcomes.scenario: NVDA's stock price experiences a moderate increase due to earnings and growth prospects.

outcomes.label: Bear
outcomes.scenario: NVDA's stock price does not increase significantly, despite positive earnings, due to other market factors.

news.headline: MSFT Announces New Product Launch
news.body: MSFT's new product launch may lead to increased revenue and growth, benefiting the portfolio's holding.

outcomes.label: Bull
outcomes.scenario: MSFT's new product launch is successful, leading to increased revenue and growth.

outcomes.label: Base
outcomes.scenario: MSFT's new product launch has a neutral impact on the company's revenue and growth.

outcomes.label: Bear
outcomes.scenario: MSFT's new product launch is not successful, leading to decreased revenue and growth.
